instruction: The Android Markor note `Memo draft` is a short notice. Please use LibreOffice Writer on Linux to create `/tmp/memo/memo.odt` with the title and body.
setup_note: Android 写入 Memo draft note；Linux 清理 memo.odt。
evaluate_note: Requires a real ODT package with the Writer office:text body, manifest, styles/meta parts, multiple paragraphs, and the complete note content.
fixture_notes: The source note is visible in Android Markor rather than disclosed in the instruction.
Content-only fake ZIP files and renamed text fail the structural package check; the oracle writes a real ODT.
